summaryZh: Praveen Raju 研究组研究儿童脑肿瘤的发育起源、形成与进展，以及如何让治疗药物跨越血脑屏障到达病灶。团队采用嵌合小鼠遗传模型，并与化学生物学团队发展 P-selectin 靶向纳米颗粒递送平台。
researchQuestions: 发育信号通路如何参与儿童脑肿瘤形成与进展？
如何提高治疗药物跨血脑屏障的病灶递送？
methods: P-selectin 靶向纳米颗粒递送

evidence.quote: Praveen Raju, MD, PhD Lab Head

Our group has a longstanding interest in developmental signaling pathways and their relationship to pediatric brain tumor formation and progression. We use sophisticated mosaic mouse genetics approaches to model pediatric brain tumors

We in collaboration with chemical biology colleagues are advancing a P-selectin targeting nanoparticle platform technology to deliver anti-cancer therapeutics including small molecule drugs and PROTAC degraders past intact blood-brain barrier (BBB) specifically at the site of intracranial disease.
study tumor cell and tumor microenvironment at single cell resolution
